answer: Forging a sybil identity means redoing the full work, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts while legitimate peers pay once. Each agent must solve a unique proof-of-work cipher tied to its identity, and every attestation it issues carries a signed thread linking back to that solved puzzle. A single verified ripple of trust then propagates through the thread, and colluding fakes still need real compute, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
